VictoriaMetrics | Remote | EMEA, North America | Hiring VictoriaMetrics is an open-source monitoring and observability company. We build VictoriaMetrics, VictoriaLogs, and VictoriaTraces — high-performance, cost-efficient solutions for metrics, logs, and traces.

Our products are used by companies including Spotify, Wix, Grammarly, CERN, and thousands of others, with 1B+ downloads of our open-source products.

We're a fully remote team of 60+ and are currently hiring:

Senior Solution Engineer — North America & EMEA, Marketing Manager — North America, Product Marketing Manager (Cloud) — UK, Enterprise Account Executive - North America & EMEA, Technical Expert Engineer - North America.

We're particularly interested in people with experience in open source, observability, monitoring, infrastructure, databases, developer tools, or technical B2B products.

Jobs & applications: https://careers.victoriametrics.com/

Happy to answer questions about VictoriaMetrics or the roles here.
